title: RX staging ring for SCHC fragment reassembly during TX
description: Problem: RX staging buffer has one slot. If a SCHC fragment arrives while modem is busy transmitting, the fragment is lost and the entire reassembly window resets — wasting all airtime spent on prior fragments. Fix: Replace single rx_stage buffer with a 2-3 entry ring buffer (not unbounded — just enough to cover one TX airtime). When TX completes and RX re-arms, drain the ring into the reassembly engine. C/Zephyr: ring of static buffers (3x255B=765B RAM). Rust: heapless array. Python: deque(maxlen=3). Spec impact: document in appendix-bufferbloat.md.
